description: List the bookmakers that quote same game parlays right now (the list grows; never assume a fixed set): name, sports, maxLegs, jurisdiction (the region the price applies to) and status (live, paused or degraded). Prefer bookmakers whose status is live; degraded means the status could not be checked and quotes may still work; paused means quotes are temporarily unavailable. Call this first, then get_sgp_legs. Included in all paid plans.

sport.description: Sport slug from get_sports. Keeps only the bookmakers that cover the sport
